data.body: [P2] Complete the design alternatives for the public API addition. Rules 2.5 and 3.3 require concrete alternatives, including simplification of existing logic, and reasons for rejecting them. The description explains why the existing anonymous capture fails, but citing #870 and stating “none simpler” does not evaluate an alternative or justify exposing a general public factory. This introduces a lasting API contract without the required scope analysis. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and document the alternatives and chosen API scope before proceeding.
